# superset_user (Resource)

Manages a user and their role memberships within Apache Superset. Supports SSO pre-provisioning via UPN (User Principal Name) for Azure AD, GitLab, Vault, and Keycloak.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pre-provision SSO User via UPN
resource "superset_user" "sso_user" {
  upn   = "user@company.com"
  roles = [superset_role.analyst.id]
}

# Local Database User
resource "superset_user" "local_admin" {
  username   = "local_admin"
  first_name = "Local"
  last_name  = "Admin"
  email      = "local_admin@company.com"
  password   = "SuperSecretPassword123!"
  active     = true
  roles      = [superset_role.analyst.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the user account is active. Defaults to true.
- `email` (String) User's email address. Defaults to 'upn' if omitted.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user. Automatically derived from UPN if not provided.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user. Automatically derived from UPN if not provided.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the user. For SSO users, if omitted, a secure random placeholder is generated.
- `roles` (List of Number) List of role IDs assigned to this user.
- `upn` (String) User Principal Name (UPN) from SSO IdP (e.g., 'user@domain.com'). If set, 'username', 'email', and names are automatically derived if not provided.
- `username` (String) Unique username for the user. Defaults to 'upn' if omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the user as a string.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import user by numeric ID
terraform import superset_user.sso_user 42
```
